title: Standard ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA/RNA Miniprep Kit for Parallel Extraction of DNA and RNA
author: Rhiannon Mondav

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Perform initial kit setup and reagent preparation.

substeps.instruction: Add 96 ml 100% ethanol (or 104 ml 95% ethanol) to the 24 ml DNA/RNA Wash Buffer concentrate.
Reconstitute lyophilized DNase I with DNase/RNase-Free Water, mix by gentle inversion, and store frozen aliquots at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Tubes and Columns
steps.instruction: Set up and label all necessary tubes and filters for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Label 4 tubes with sample ID (2 as 'RNA', 2 as 'DNA').
Label 5 collection tubes with sample ID (2 as 'DNA', 2 as 'RNA').
Place a yellow filter in one DNA collection tube.
Place a green column in one RNA collection tube.
Place HRC filters in two collection tubes, one labeled DNA and one labeled RNA.

steps.title: Thaw and Transfer Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample slurry based on the initial storage state.

substeps.instruction: For liquid nitrogen flash frozen samples: Transfer 0.25 g sample to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube, add 750 µl DNA/RNA Shield, cap tightly, vortex briefly, and vortex briefly 2-3 more times during thaw.
For samples in DNA/RNA Shield (including -80°C samples): Thaw on ice, vortexing briefly every five minutes (may take 30+ minutes).
Set pipette to 800 µl, vortex briefly or invert, and transfer 750 µl of slurry (using a pre-cut pipette tip) to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube and cap tightly.

steps.title: Bead Beat Samples
steps.instruction: Mechanically lyse the samples using a bead beater.

substeps.instruction: Label the side of the BB Lysis Tube with sample ID.
Bead beat on MP Bio FastPrep for 60 seconds at 6.5 m/s, then rest for 5 minutes.
Repeat this cycle four more times (total of 5 minutes bead beating).

steps.title: Prepare DNase Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNase Master Mix and store on ice. Use the following ratios per sample:

substeps.instruction: 1 sample: 5 µl DNase I and 75 µl DNase dgstn buffer
6 samples: 30 µl DNase I and 450 µl DNase dgstn buffer
8 samples: 40 µl DNase I and 600 µl DNase dgstn buffer
12 samples: 60 µl DNase I and 900 µl DNase dgstn buffer
24 samples: 120 µl DNase I and 1800 µl DNase dgstn buffer

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Filtration
steps.instruction: Separate the DNA from the sample slurry.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 400 µl of DNA/RNA Lysis Buffer into a nuclease-free tube for each sample and label with sample ID.
Centrifuge samples at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds.
Transfer 400 µl of the supernatant to the tube containing lysis buffer and mix well by inversion (total volume 800 µl).
Pour or pipette the sample into a yellow Spin-Away™ Filter in a collection tube and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds.
Transfer the yellow filter containing DNA into a new Collection Tube and store. SAVE the flow-through for later.

steps.title: Process RNA Flow-through
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from the flow-through of the yellow filter.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 800 µl of 95-100% ethanol into a nuclease-free tube for each sample, label as 'RNA', and close tightly.
Transfer the 800 µl flow-through from the yellow filter step to the tube with ethanol, close tightly, and mix by inversion (total volume 1600 µl).
Transfer 700 µl of the RNA mixture into a Zymo-Spin™ IIICG Column (green) in a collection tube and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds; discard flow-through.
Repeat the transfer and centrifuge process twice more until all RNA solution has passed through the green column.

steps.title: Wash and Treat RNA Column
steps.instruction: Clean the RNA column and remove DNA using DNase.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the green column, centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds, and discard flow-through.
Add 80 µl DNase I Master Mix to the green column and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Elute DNA and RNA
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and elute the nucleic acids from the filters/columns.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Prep Buffer to the yellow filter and green column; centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds and discard flow-through.
Add 700 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the yellow filter and green column; centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds and discard flow-through.
Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the yellow filter and green column; centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 2 minutes to ensure complete removal of buffer.
Carefully transfer the columns into new tubes and discard the previous tubes and flow-through.
Add 100 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the yellow filter and green column matrix.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds to elute DNA and RNA.

steps.title: HRC Filter Preparation and Final Elution
steps.instruction: Prepare HRC filters and perform final cleanup of eluted DNA and RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ HRC Prep Solution to a Zymo-Spin™ III-HRC Filter in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 3 minutes, discard the collection tube and flow-through, and transfer the III-HRC Filter to a new tube.
Transfer the eluted DNA and RNA from the previous step into the prepared Zymo-Spin™ III-HRC Filters.
Centrifuge at exactly 16,000 x g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Sample Storage and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Finalize samples for storage and testing.

substeps.instruction: Discard the filter, close the tube lid, and place on ice.
Pipette 3 to 10 µl of each sample into new tubes for purity, quantity, and quality testing.
Store actual samples in -20°C or -80°C freezers.
Optionally, make 5 µl and 10 µl aliquots for downstream testing.
